en: Color postcard showing a hillside urban landscape. On the top of the hill stands a large, white, modernist terraced hotel or sanatorium surrounded by trees. Below are several mid‑rise apartment blocks with balconies, a curving road with a few cars, and a long zigzagging pedestrian path or stairway climbing the slope. The setting is lush and green under a bright blue sky with large white clouds. No legible printed text is visible on the image side.
